subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept a defaults-wide agents.defaults.bootstrapTier config surface after the pending-BOOTSTRAP safety fix, or redesign tiered bootstrap policy around a narrower per-agent/bootstrap-profile model?
rationale: The line-level BOOTSTRAP regression is mechanical, but adding a public context/session-state default affects prompt behavior, hook extras, setup expectations, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals.

options.title: Accept after safety/docs fixes
options.body: Keep this PR as the implementation path once pending BOOTSTRAP.md is preserved and public docs/tests cover the config behavior.

options.title: Redesign as profile policy
options.body: Pause this branch and move the idea toward per-agent or bootstrap-profile controls if a global defaults-wide tier is too broad.

options.title: Defer the config surface
options.body: Close or park the PR if maintainers want existing budgets, context modes, or future context-management work to handle this use case instead.

recommendation.title: Accept after safety/docs fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the implementation path once pending BOOTSTRAP.md is preserved and public docs/tests cover the config behavior.
